Diário de Dev #12 — Foco em pinheirinho, ark-streams e mais 1 projetos

Período: 2026-03-19 a 2026-03-25

Este é o diário de bordo semanal registrando as entregas feitas nos repositórios pinheirinho, ark-streams, reconciler.

🚀 Conquistas da Semana

Projeto: pinheirinho

  • [2c6cb83] fix(rules): implement fixes for red light timeout, alignment foul, and tree sequence for WO

Projeto: ark-streams

  • [9e16379] style: rename Nexus Explorer to Nexus Terminal in header
  • [60cbc0e] feat: add Market Overview route with synced multi-asset charts and Profitunity strategy guide
  • [752e200] fix: enforce positive values for all candle fields in Yahoo Finance data to prevent Alligator distortions
  • [e66282f] fix: resolve IBOVESPA infinite candle bug by adding price sanity checks across API, collector, and frontend
  • [53bc38f] feat: enable network-wide access for Nexus Terminal and dynamic API endpoints
  • [7433c64] fix: adjust chart timezone to local browser time
  • [b92475a] feat: add Market Confluence and Economic Calendar views to Nexus Terminal
  • [7133ba3] feat: add confluence and economic calendar endpoints to the API
  • [57c14bf] feat: implement Market Confluence view and enhance USDBRL/IBOV chart visualization
  • [68f2f56] feat: add flush_position utility to clear ghost positions from NATS/JetStream
  • [86ea4fc] perf: implement zero-latency tab switching and state stability in Nexus Terminal
  • [e550e8b] feat: enhance Profitunity strategy and USDBRL chart visualization
  • [9d05249] fix: update DXY ticker to DX-Y.NYB and improve Yahoo Finance User-Agent to resolve empty price data
  • [1a21321] feat: enhance positions display and remove mock data from JetStream
  • [98162f1] feat: implement real-time Bitget positions tracking with two-phase snapshot/live sync in backend and frontend
  • [62acaee] fix: deduplicate chart data to prevent lightweight-charts assertion failure

Projeto: reconciler

  • [900ccfd] feat(ui): implement financial reconciliation engine with Fulcro

🛠️ Tecnologias e Camadas

Nesta semana, as seguintes frentes foram trabalhadas:

  • pinheirinho: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
  • ark-streams: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
  • reconciler: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
